text: This report seeks approval of new HR policies and programs for CreateTO as a result of the transfer of staff from Build Toronto ("BT") and Toronto Port Lands Company ("TPLC") to CreateTO.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Adopted the following policies, attached in Appendix A to the report (May 30, 2018) from the Transition Lead, CreateTO: a. Accessibility b. Code of Conduct c. Disclosure of Wrongdoing and Reprisal Protection d. Domestic Violence Policy and Program e. Employment Equity f. Health and Safety g. Jury Duty / Witness Service h. Personal Days i. Personal Emergency Leave j. Pregnancy / Parental Leave k. Privacy l. Use of Resources During an Election Period m. Vacation n. Workplace Harassment and Discrimination Policy and Program. 2. Adopted the Compensation and Benefit HR programs outlined in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 30, 2018) from the Transition Lead, CreateTO. 3.
